teaser: What does it cost to be the one everyone leans on? You are an 8 who is also an ISTJ, and that question sits under most ordinary days without ever getting asked outright. The 8 climbs toward control of the material world — money, authority, the structures that move things. The ISTJ holds the line so everything else can keep functioning. In you, the climbing and the holding happen in the same motion: ambition that looks like discipline, discipline that looks like ambition. Nobody mistakes you for reckless. Few notice how much weight is actually being carried.
